questions.text: Did the agent verify the customer's identity?
questions.helpText: YES if the agent asked for an account number, email or order ID before discussing the account. N/A if the conversation never touched account details.

questions.text: Did the agent confirm the issue was resolved before ending the conversation?
questions.helpText: YES if the agent asked whether the issue was resolved or whether the customer needed anything else, in the last three agent turns.
